jobs.description:
The opportunity Join our collaborative OSS team and support daily IT operations close to the business. You ensure employees have reliable devices and a smooth digital workplace experience. In this hands‑on role, you learn how to troubleshoot technical issues and prepare essential IT equipment. You work closely with end users and gain valuable insights into how IT drives productivity. Throughout the 12 months internship, experienced colleagues support your growth and development. How   you'll   make an impact Assist   in troubleshooting basic IT issues, p repare laptops and other devices so they are ready for use by new or existing employees Support end users   in   navigating self ‑ service tools and standard IT procedures Assist with stock handling, asset pickup\/return, and device preparation for onboarding\/offboarding Support warranty processes by gathering information and preparing devices Help   maintain   IT equipment in meeting rooms and shared office spaces, ensuring systems   operate   correctly Update documentation related to device preparation and OSS procedures and report issues to the team.   Be   engaged in special projects where you   make impact ( relocating , changing office set-up,   set   up infrastructure,   set-up   of the meeting rooms)   Be engaged in special   on ‑ site   projects, such as office relocations,   changes   to office layouts, infrastructure setup, and preparation or reconfiguration of meeting rooms, contributing directly to how the workplace functions   Your background Currently studying at a university or technical school (EFZ) in IT, computer science, engineering, or a related field Comfortable working with people   and with   following established procedures   and   you are passionate about making things better Basic understanding of computer hardware and operating systems Eager to learn and develop technical skills in a hands ‑ on environment Strong problem ‑ solving mindset and good attention to detail Good communication skills in English and German More about us We are a technology-driven company with a strong focus on innovation, continuous improvement, and sustainable manufacturing. 
• We offer flexible working conditions, dedicated mentorship, and a supportive, inclusive environment where you can grow personally and professionally – empowering you to thrive while balancing life and work. We look forward to receiving your application, including a brief cover letter and a transcript of records, along with your CV. Non-EU\/EFTA citizens, please note that an official university certificate showing that an internship is a mandatory part of your studies is required.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti al nostro team di OSS collaborativo e supporta le operazioni IT quotidiane vicino al business. Garantisci ai dipendenti di avere dispositivi affidabili e un'esperienza di lavoro digitale fluida. In questo ruolo pratico, impari come risolvere problemi tecnici e preparare attrezzature IT essenziali. Si lavora a stretto contatto con gli utenti finali e ottenere preziose informazioni su come l'IT guida la produttività. Durante i 12 mesi di stage, colleghi esperti sostengono la vostra crescita e sviluppo. Come farete un impatto Assist nella risoluzione dei problemi IT di base, nel ripristino dei computer portatili e di altri dispositivi in modo che siano pronti per l'uso da parte di dipendenti nuovi o esistenti Supporta gli utenti finali nella navigazione di strumenti di self-service e procedure IT standard Assistere con la gestione delle scorte, il recupero degli asset\/ritorno e la preparazione dei dispositivi per i problemi di bordo\/offboarding Processi di garanzia di supporto raccogliendo informazioni e preparando i dispositivi IT Essere impegnato in progetti speciali in cui si effettua l'impatto (locazione, cambiamento dell'assetto dell'ufficio, istituire infrastrutture, impostare le sale riunioni) Essere impegnato in progetti speciali sul sito, come rilocali per uffici, modifiche ai layout per uffici, installazione delle infrastrutture, preparazione o riconfigurazione delle sale riunioni, contribuendo direttamente a come funziona il luogo di lavoro Attualmente studiando presso una scuola universitaria o tecnica (EFZ) in IT, informatica, ingegneria o un campo correlato Lavorare con le persone e con le seguenti procedure consolidate e si è appassionati di rendere le cose migliori La comprensione di base dell'hardware e dei sistemi operativi Eager per imparare e sviluppare competenze tecniche in una mani ‐ su ambiente Forte problema ‐ risolvere mindset e buona attenzione ai dettagli Buone capacità di comunicazione in inglese e tedesco Più su di noi Siamo una società di sviluppo continuo con un forte focus

As Improvement Project Manager – Data & Digital Analytics, you will work at the intersection of business, data, and technology, driving data driven initiatives that improve operational efficiency, transparency, and decision-making quality. You will design and deliver scalable digital and analytics solutions using modern cloud technologies, enabling standardized KPIs, reliable insights, and sustainable automation. Through close cross‑functional collaboration, you translate engineering requirements into robust sourcing solutions and support supplier qualification and technical alignment. Your role contributes directly to product quality, supply reliability, and operational excellence, enabling Hitachi Energy to deliver innovative and sustainable energy solutions to our customers worldwide. Hitachi Energy, Prodotti ad alta tensione La nostra azienda è nota a livello mondiale come specialista per la trasmissione e la distribuzione di energia. L'unità di Servizio è responsabile del supporto post-vendita a livello mondiale per i sistemi di circuito-breaker per generatori (GCB) e per le sostanze di commutazione isolate con gas (GIS), compresi la formazione, l'installazione e la commissione, la manutenzione programmata, i servizi di valore aggiunto, la risoluzione dei problemi, gli estensioni, i retrofit e le sostituzioni. Descrizione del ruolo Come Acquirente Tecnico, agirai come interfaccia chiave tra Procurement, Ingegneria, Qualità e la nostra rete globale di fornitori. Assicurerai che i materiali, i componenti e i servizi specificiti tecnologicimente chiaramente definiti, chiariti, qualificati e disponibili in linea con le esigenze dei progetti, della qualità e della consegna. Attraverso una stretta collaborazione interfunzionale, traduirai le esigenze di ingegneria in soluzioni di approvvigionamento robuste e supporterai la qualifica dei fornitori e l'allineamento tecnico. Il tuo ruolo diretto alla qualità dei prodotti, alla affidabilità delle forniture e all'eccellenza operativa, volendo a Hitachi Energy di fornire soluzioni innovative e sostenibili per l'energia ai nostri clienti in tutto il mondo. Come realizzare un impatto - Esegui la chiarificazione tecnica dei materiali, dei disegni, delle specifiche e delle modifiche ingegneristiche in stretta collaborazione con l'Ingegneria e i fornitori. - Supporta e coordina le attività del Processo di Approvazione dei Parti di Produzione (PPAP), le prime prove e i processi di classificazione dei fornitori. - Conduci le necessarie tecniche di materiali alternativi, richieste di deviazione e boss di obsolescenza. - Collabora diretta con gli Acquirenti Strategici e Operativi sui temi relativi ai fornitori e ai materiali. - Supporta l'organizzazione e la gestione delle lamentele dei fornitori, dei Rapporti di Non Conformità (NCR) e delle analisi di causa radice. - Supporta e partecipa alle competenze dei fornitori e alle dirette tecniche dei fornitori, comprese le recensioni della capacità, della qualità e della maturità dei processi. - Contribuisce alle prestazioni dei fornitori insieme con la Qualità e la Procurement Strategica. - Assicura l'accuratezza e la completezza dei dati di master dei materiali e dei fornitori nel SAP e agiscono come punto di contatto tecnico durante le escalazioni dei fornitori. - Supporta l'Organizzazione di Servizio e le Squadre di Progetto in materia di approvvigionamento complessivo o urgenti.

jobs.title: Research Scientist – Physics of Failure & Reliability (f/m/d)
jobs.description: The opportunity   Empower the Future with Hitachi Energy: Join us as a Scientist in Physics of Failure & Reliability. We are looking for a passionate and proficient scientist to join us in reliability research for power grid assets and systems.  As part of our dynamic, motivated, and creative team, you'll bridge theory and application, developing, testing, and validating novel methods and technologies to facilitate the energy transition. How you'll make an impact You drive impact : Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects by focusing on the underlying physics of failure, ensuring that reliability enhancements for power grid assets are grounded in a deep understanding of how application stresses translate into real-world failure mechanisms. Prioritize integrating physical failure models into data analysis, so that every solution is both scientifically robust and directly relevant to operational challenges You innovate : Proactively seek out emerging knowledge in failure physics and ensure that data collected and analysed reflects the true physical processes affecting system reliability, keeping the team at the cutting edge of reliability science and its practical applications You take initiative : Collaborate with a global team of researchers and engineers in Hitachi Energy Research and Hitachi Energy business units to identify and solve real-world problems and realize opportunities for further improvements You connect : Build relationships within the company and actively share your knowledge and expertise You communicate : Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports Your background PhD in physics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, or related field Expertise in physics of failure, failure investigation, root-cause analysis, and reliability modeling, all with strong attention to practical application, data analysis and accurate interpretation Industry or post-doc experience (in energy technology or other industries like automotive, rail, aerospace, telecommunication) in developing and implementing product reliability improvements is a plus Fluency in English, both written and spoken More about us At Hitachi Energy, we believe in the power of diversity and the potential of every person. We are committed creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We invite you to apply and join us in shaping a sustainable future.

jobs.description: The opportunity Join a high performing photolithography team where your expertise truly makes an impact. As a Senior Photolithography Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and optimizing photolithography processes used in semiconductor manufacturing. Your role will involve working with advanced lithography equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring high-quality production standards. This is your opportunity to shape technical decisions, contribute to long term tool strategies, and drive meaningful improvements in stability, uptime, and process performance. Are you someone who takes ownership, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and enjoys making a real impact? Then apply today! Engage with equipment and material vendors to develop new solutions and improve existing processes, to ensure smooth functioning of the production line. Develop new techniques, modify existing designs, and coordinate process improvement projects. Analyze process data to identify trends, optimize performance, and troubleshoot issues (implement and regularly check SPC). Independent planning and Implementation of new machinery into the production line. Work closely with process integration, wet etch, diffusion, metals, dry etch, and implant teams to ensure seamless production. Supports some metrology tools i.e. to measure CD and Overlay. On-call duties on weekends and public holidays (as required from the production) with participation in the on-call meeting (before the on-call duty) agreed on his own responsibility with the other on-call service providers. Your background Bachelor's degree in a related field (e.g., Electrical, Mechanical, Chemical, Materials Science or Physics) with 5+ years of experience in industry or master's degree with 3+ years of experience in industry or Ph.D. with industry experience Extensive experience in wafer photolithography operations especially in coating and exposure in Steppers, in a wafer manufacturing environment (thin-film-head, semiconductor wafer manufacturing) Familiarity with automated wafer factory software systems like SPC, MES and Experience with data extraction, manipulation, and analysis Strong understanding of optics and immersion lithography Proficiency in data science and programming is preferred Good English and German language skills Ability to work in a cleanroom environment More about us Our flexible working practices help you optimize personal and business performance while creating an environment where all employees can develop their skills and grow.

jobs.title: Global Manufacturing Process Lead - Transformer Cores Fabrication
jobs.description: The opportunity The Global Manufacturing Process Lead - GPG DT - Transformer Cores Fabrication is responsible for defining, leading, and continuously improving the end-to-end engineering and manufacturing-related processes for transformers magnetic cores within the Global Product Group (GPG), covering distribution transformers, dry-type transformers, and traction transformers. This role has a strong focus on core manufacturing processes, including lamination handling, cutting, stacking, core assembly, clamping, insulation interfaces, losses control, dimensional accuracy, and industrialization readiness, ensuring alignment between design, manufacturing, suppliers, and digital platforms. The position supports the “Design Anywhere, Manufacture Anywhere” strategy by standardizing processes, enabling digital tools, and ensuring that best practices in core manufacturing engineering are consistently deployed across factories worldwide. The role drives Lean, Digital Transformation, and Value Stream improvements, ensuring speed, quality, and robustness of magnetic core processes while reducing manual activities and variability. Close collaboration with Factory Engineering Process Managers, Digital Transformation Leads, Platform\/Tool teams, and Supply Chain is essential. How you'll make an impact You own global engineering and manufacturing processes for magnetic cores. You set clear standards that ensure quality, consistency, and efficiency. You standardize how cores are designed, built, and assembled worldwide. You ensure processes scale across factories and production volumes. You review processes regularly and drive continuous improvement. You improve efficiency, quality, and lead times through structured improvements. You identify where automation and digital tools add real value. You define requirements for tools that support design and manufacturing. You connect engineering with operations, supply chain, and suppliers. You lead a global network that applies standards safely and consistently. Your background You hold a degree in electrical, mechanical, industrial engineering, or similar. Or you bring equivalent long‑term practical experience. You have extensive experience in engineering or manufacturing environments. You bring deep exposure to magnetic cores or transformer manufacturing. You understand industrial processes for complex electromechanical products. You have a strong background in process engineering and continuous improvement. You have led complex initiatives across functions and countries. You work confidently with digital tools that support engineering and production. You communicate clearly and influence senior stakeholders effectively.​ More about us We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefits to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We provide competitive salaries, flexible working hours, professional development opportunities, and a supportive work environment that encourages growth and innovation. Specific benefits depend on the location and will be communicated during the interview process. Applications are open until 15th of June.
